correctness.rationale: The claim is a finite theorem over all 65535 nonempty subsets of a sixteen-point group. Fourier zero tests are exact Gaussian-integer sums; translation normalization for spectra and complements is lossless because both criteria depend only on differences; the difference-set criterion plus the product cardinality is equivalent to unique tiling. The reviewed verifier checked equality of the spectral and tiling predicates for every subset and independently partitioned all positive cases under the full affine group.

value.rationale: Z4^2 is the first square group Z_{p^2}^2 and lies immediately beyond the positive two-generator families summarized in the anchor literature. The result is not merely a spot check: it gives the exact positive/negative partition of all 65535 nonempty subsets, exact cardinality counts, and the complete affine-orbit count. This provides a sharp small-group boundary datum next to recent failures in larger p-groups.
